Parent GarmentArmorDesign validates the shape against Tassets kind, admits lame_count 1–12 and requires section_break < lame_count. The selected editor transition immediately invokes wrapped controls, which caps break at count.saturating_sub(1); the warm-up selects eight lames before adding default Wrapped (6 < 8). The low-level wrapped entry validates the parent before dividing by count.
